mission: Build a practical kids activity site whose durable advantage is original, parent-useful research synthesis with honestly labeled evidence; never imply testing that did not occur.

active_sprint.activation_receipt: Saved app config matches reviewed prompt/hourly cadence; version, ID, kind, name, status, thread, created_at and absent notification setting preserved.
active_sprint.restoration: At expiry or direct early stop, restore exact baseline through the same app automation; verify saved fields, record restored status, return without project work. Unconfirmed restoration blocks project work on that run.

release_policy: Standing authorization granted 2026-07-17 for exact-path, independently reviewed, QA-green pushes and GitHub Pages deployments. The fixed daily substantive-action and commit cap was removed 2026-07-28. Multiple sequential transactions are allowed when each has one registered action, exact scope, required review, focused commit, and release verification. Stop on divergence or ambiguous rollback scope.
